method.identity_matching: Exact arXiv identifier, or exact title after case/punctuation/diacritic/markup normalization. Explicitly identified review and composite-part title mappings are separately labelled. Candidate position and old bibliography numbering are not identity evidence.
method.json_pointer_format: RFC 6901; ~1 encodes a slash within an arXiv-key token.
method.source_read_vs_metadata: A metadata lookup match establishes only an identity link to a historical record. It does not establish source reading, correctness of every citation field, or validation of any manuscript claim.
method.fresh_checks: Current primary metadata checks (2026-09-18): arXiv abstract pages for references 81 and 82, and three INSPIRE API records (18221, 444838, 445039) to resolve references 2 and 12. No bulk external re-verification of other entries was performed.
method.historical_status: VERIFIED, CANDIDATES and UNVERIFIED are original historical lookup labels, not verdicts assigned to present manuscript claims.

limitations: The five supplied logs are historical and include records unrelated to the current bibliography. Only matched rows are assigned here.

Coverage is limited to the supplied records: eight current entries have no matching historical row; reference 1 has only related review/catalogue records; references 81–82 rely on separate current arXiv metadata checks. Current INSPIRE API checks resolve the historic logging discrepancy for reference 2 and the former identifier discrepancy for reference 12. The manuscript now describes this limited metadata coverage explicitly.
Absence of a historical match does not mean a citation is false, and lack of an arXiv identifier is not itself a deficiency.
No per-claim source validation, journal-page/DOI re-verification, or proof of source reading is asserted. Known source-access limitations are retained from the manuscript.
